body:
kai: quick check — docs mention both `model_id` and `model_selector` for the /generate endpoint. For the canary rollout in eu region, which should callers prefer? also how do fallbacks behave if the selector includes a tier?

miriam: short answer: `model_id` is for exact pinning. `model_selector` is a hint (tier/region/compat) we can use to pick a best-fit model and gracefully fallback. We need to make the fallback ordering explicit in the contract though.

aj: +1 to miriam. current runtime behavior: if `model_id` present we serve that exact variant (error if not available), if only `model_selector` we do matching by: 1) region+tier exact, 2) region any tier, 3) cross-region same tier, 4) global best-fit. We added a fallback log field to responses.

kai: can you paste an example request/response shape? will update SDK docs in the PR.

miriam: example request we want in docs:
```json
{
  "prompt": "summarize...",
  "model_selector": {"family": "redwood-rl", "tier": "dedicated", "region": "eu-west-1", "min_compat": "v2"},
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```
example response shape we agreed on (important for backward compatibility):
```json
{
  "id": "resp_...",
  "text": "...",
  "served_model": {"served_model_id": "redwood-rl-ded-1", "family": "redwood-rl", "tier": "dedicated", "region": "eu-west-1", "compat_version": "v2"},
  "fallback_chain": ["eu-west-1:ded-1","eu-west-1:std-2","us-west-2:ded-3"]
}
```

serge: small contract note: "served_model" must be stable in shape (keys and types). Clients parse served_model.served_model_id; if we rename fields it will break. Add a schema in openapi and a short migration guide for any changes.

aj: implementational detail — if both `model_id` and `model_selector` supplied, `model_id` wins (no implicit validation against selector). We should return a 400 if `model_selector.min_compat` > model's compat (unless `allow_lower_compat` flag present).

kai: ok. proposal: docs + openapi patch that: 1) documents precedence rules, 2) adds served_model schema, 3) returns `X-Model-Deprecation` header when client uses deprecated selector fields. I'll open a PR after lunch. pinging @miriam for review and @aj for infra signoff.

infra-bot: canary toggle for eu fallback enabled on infra-canary-3. Will route 5% traffic to new selector resolver.

miriam: thanks. one more ops ask: add telemetry event `selector_fallback` with fields: requested_selector, matched_served_model_id, step_index. helps evals.

aj: good call. infra team will ship telemetry mapping.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs PR #482 merged -> will publish staging docs site at 15:40 UTC.

kai: great, i'll open PR and drop the openapi snippet. will follow up when staging is live. :thumbsup:

serge: ack, will watch for schema change note in release notes.

miriam: thanks all — keeping this small is good. Any objections to the header deprecation approach?

aj: no objections. we should add a two-week announcement in #announcements before flipping stricter validation.

kai: noted, will schedule.

(ended async)
